title: Desk Ruling on Commissions Running at the Same Time for One Customer
content:
# Desk Ruling on Commissions Running at the Same Time for One Customer

**Ruling.** Under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions one customer may have several commissions running, but each programme caps how many of its own commissions may run for one customer at a time, and the studio's own cap is 3 commissions running for one customer at once. A further commission is opened for a customer only when no commission already recorded against the same commission reference stands at consultation, design approval, deposit pending, in production, on hold, awaiting final payment or ready for delivery. A commission that has been delivered or cancelled no longer counts against the cap, and a customer at the cap is offered a place in the studio's book rather than a second open commission.

## What the desk reads before a commission is opened

| Question | Where the answer comes from | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Does a commission already recorded against the same commission reference stand open? | The commission records: the commission reference, the status and the customer it belongs to | Open means standing at any of consultation, design approval, deposit pending, in production, on hold, awaiting final payment or ready for delivery; delivered and cancelled are closed |
| How many of this programme's commissions does the customer have running? | The count of the customer's commissions standing at those open states | Compared with the programme's own cap on commissions running at once per customer |

The answer is taken from the commission records as they stand before the commission is opened; the customer's account of what they hold does not stand in for the records. The correlation is by commission reference: a record counts against a reference only where it carries that same reference.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A customer holds one commission standing delivered and one standing cancelled, both under a programme whose cap is 2. Neither counts against the cap, and a further commission may be opened.
- A customer holds two commissions standing in production under a programme whose cap is 2. The customer is at the cap and is offered a place in the studio's book.
- A record against the same commission reference stands at awaiting final payment. It is open, and no further commission is opened against that reference.
